description: Repairs r-par-1/err-snapshot-last-bad-row: the loop stepped past EOF. Asks, for SELECT id, 1 / zl AS e FROM ER (zl = 0 at id 240, the last row) as a snapshot, which of OpenRecordset, EOF, MoveLast, RecordCount, the read of e at the last row or the MoveNext past it raises the error, with reads bounded to rows that exist: id and e after the open, after MoveLast, after MoveFirst, and rows 237 to 240 after Move(236), then EOF. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
